answer_map.answer_en: Zhongzhiyuan uses a parallel proof court and physical stop; Origin uses one street, two courts, four nodes and point withdrawal; Dazhongsi uses a four-way commute, off-route publishing and staffed service.

answer_map.question_en: Why can Zhongzhiyuan, Origin and Dazhongsi not copy one another?
answer_map.question_zh: 众智园、原点社区和大钟寺为什么不能互相复制？

answer_map.answer_en: The proof track is a voluntary, announced, bounded, stoppable and removable side task overlay, not coordinates, a continuous footprint or a construction alignment.
answer_map.answer_zh: 验证轨是自愿、公告、限域、可停止、可拆除的旁侧任务叠层，不是坐标、连续足迹或建设线位。
answer_map.question_en: Why is the proof track not continuous occupation?
answer_map.question_zh: 验证轨为什么不是连续占地？

answer_map.answer_en: The proof overlay stops and isolates; the ordinary track, complete non-AI route, screen-free information, staffed takeover, withdrawal, appeal and safe exit continue.
answer_map.answer_zh: 验证叠层停止并隔离；日常轨、完整非 AI 路径、无屏信息、人工接管、撤回、申诉和安全离开继续。
answer_map.question_en: What stops and what continues on failure?
answer_map.question_zh: 发生故障时停止什么、保留什么？

answer_map.answer_en: Recovery first returns the ordinary route and service; real acceptance and GO remain zero, so an open gap means G0, closed or retired.
answer_map.answer_zh: 恢复只先还普通路径和服务；现实验收与 GO 为 0，未闭合就保持 G0、关闭或退役。
answer_map.question_en: Why is recovery not G1, approval or restart?
answer_map.question_zh: 恢复为什么不等于 G1、批准或重新运行？

answer_map.answer_en: All site and key-area containers remain provisional; official redlines, alignment, anchors, dimensions, materials, connections and specialist conclusions remain unknown.
answer_map.answer_zh: 全部场地与重点区容器仍为临时约束；官方红线、套准、锚点、尺寸、材料、连接和专项结论仍未知。
answer_map.question_en: Which spatial information remains provisional or unknown?
answer_map.question_zh: 哪些空间信息仍是临时或未知？

answer_map.answer_en: D01-D08 replace provisional inputs; H01-H07 are still-unsubmitted evidence handoff packs; P01-P07 are suggested discipline types only. A future competent professional who accepts an exact scope may recalculate, revise, condition, reject or delete the affected concept within that scope; a major gap keeps NO-GO.
answer_map.answer_zh: D01—D08 替换临时输入；H01—H07 是仍未提交的证据交接包；P01—P07 只是建议专业类型。未来胜任且接受明确范围的专业方可在该范围内复算、修改、附条件、拒绝或删除受影响概念；重大缺口保持 NO-GO。
answer_map.question_en: Which inputs, handoff packs and suggested discipline types control revision, rejection or deletion?
answer_map.question_zh: 哪些资料、交接包和建议专业类型控制修改、拒绝或删除方案？
